conditional: skills/gdo-workflow/references/verification-recipe.md for product-code handoff continuing to Evidence
classify the blocker using workflow core only; if executable observation is needed, route to Discovery first; Governance Triage never owns a Discovery Probe

budgets_bytes.rationale: Reviewable anti-bloat ceiling for complete standard-role required loads. GDO 4.6 raises the prior 32,000-byte working ceiling to 34,000 to accommodate Evidence Admission/proof-ledger publication contracts without compressing or deleting safeguards; this is not a runtime correctness limit.

actor_override.semantics: TAKEOVER replaces the actor for one dispatch only; contract effect is NONE; automation resumes only through a new continuation/new dispatch.

correction_economy.defect_aggregation: Evidence may continue independent useful authorized checks after a failure when safe; aggregate related demonstrated failures without speculative expansion.
correction_economy.implementation_completeness: Implementation resolves explicit findings and the directly implicated bounded failure class, while avoiding unrelated refactor/scope expansion.
correction_economy.later_round_evidence: Fresh Evidence round is not a fresh campaign; retain applicable proof and execute only failed, blocked/missing, concretely invalidated, explicitly fresh, or directly affected obligations.

lifecycle_comments.principle: Compress prose, never provenance. Lifecycle comments are delta-oriented control-plane records.
must_preserve: source/tested SHA and branch when relevant
lifecycle_comments.correction_packet: Evidence->Implementation and Implementation->Evidence must preserve the GDO 4.2 correction boundary and proof disposition.

targeted_development_checks.semantics: One bounded candidate-specific check executed as development feedback inside an active Implementation round. It is not Evidence and cannot satisfy REVIEW READY or PASS.
executors: other authorized testing agent or harness

executor_modes.AUTO: Dispatch through the configured lightweight testing backend; backend identity is transport/runtime configuration, not GDO authority.
executor_modes.HUMAN: Do not launch an automated testing worker; a human performs the bounded check and posts the canonical result.

discovery_probes.semantics: One bounded executable experiment used as discovery feedback when source/document/native inspection cannot confidently resolve a material uncertainty. It is source/architecture evidence only, not product authority or acceptance Evidence.
executors: other authorized lightweight executor or harness
discovery_probes.multi_observation_rule: One probe owns one bounded Discovery uncertainty, but its minimal experiment may contain multiple tightly coupled observations needed to distinguish the alternatives.
discovery_probes.product_branch_rule: Probe code is normally outside the product branch or removed before Discovery completion. Durable research code is allowed only when the active Discovery contract explicitly authorizes it as a deliverable.
discovery_probes.human_takeover_rule: A Human-owned Discovery may launch an AUTO subordinate probe; the result is durable GitHub feedback but must not resurrect the superseded automated Governance worker.
discovery_probes.formal_evidence_rule: Probe observations may inform architecture/source truth but cannot satisfy acceptance criteria, REVIEW READY, Independent Review, or PASS.

evidence_admission.scope: new opt-in Implementation READY FOR EVIDENCE / TESTING handoffs only
evidence_admission.semantics: Runner control-plane readiness only. ADMITTED may launch the normal fresh Evidence worker; NOT_READY/TRIAGE_REQUIRED launch no Evidence round. Admission never closes proof, REVIEW READY, or PASS.
evidence_admission.frozen_request_rule: Handoffs without the explicit admission marker retain legacy direct-Evidence routing; package/version changes never opt frozen work in.

lifecycle_publication.semantics: New admission-enabled Implementation handoffs submit structured fields; runner publication renders and validates the canonical implementation-record:v3 and preserves request identity.
